description: Free; reads only. Looks up one of your earlier account calls by its request id (given after every charged run_tool result and in errors): whether it is running, succeeded or failed, what it was charged, and its result again. Use it to recover a result after a dropped connection instead of paying twice: a call can't be cancelled and keeps running to the end even if you disconnect. list_calls finds request ids. Needs an account API key on the connection; x402 calls are not looked up here.

request_id.description: The request id, a UUID such as 3f2b6c1e-8d4a-4f7e-9a1b-2c3d4e5f6a7b.

name: get_call
title: Look up an earlier call
